assumptions: Each motif is the published one, cited at its declaration.
limits: No risk score: the sources name motifs, not rates, so a hit is a flag to check rather than a predicted failure.
Sequence motifs only: structure and formulation decide whether one matters.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the list of motif hits with their rule, region and source, which the outputs carry; the Antibody panel counts them inside the numbering sentence, which needs number_antibody's germline too.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which sequence liabilities does this variable domain carry, and in which IMGT region does each sit?

description: Scan antibody and TCR variable domains for sequence liabilities (Asn deamidation, Asp isomerization, N-glycosylation sequons, Asp-Pro cleavage, Met and Trp oxidation, unpaired or missing conserved cysteines), each placed in its IMGT region so CDR hits can be told from framework ones. Every motif is cited to its source.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

cdrOnly.description: report only liabilities that start inside a CDR.

name: antibody_liabilities

cdrCount.description: number of reported liabilities inside a CDR

liabilities.description: each hit: rule, motif, 0-based start and end, IMGT positions, region, whether in a CDR, source
